method: Draft pass, mechanical gate (authored-bank.mjs), then a separate critical pass per family asking: unresolved tie for best? invented rule or fact? wrong primary skill? arithmetic or calendar ambiguity? Single reader (the drafting model, in a separate pass). Agreement is evidence, not proof.
limits: No independent evaluator or human reviewer was used.
Keys were not tested against student data.
Fail-closed rule: a family that cannot be repaired is excluded, none were excluded this session because every flagged defect was repairable.

repairs.defect: best answer relied on an invented fact (note 'no longer needed')
repairs.repair: keyed answer now locks both items; scenario facts unchanged

repairs.defect: distractor (count stock yourself) was a possible tie with the key
repairs.repair: replaced with a distractor that misattributes work under your account
replaced with sharing specific exam situations, clearly confidential content

repairs.defect: 'within one business day' did not clearly beat the deadline
repairs.repair: IT page now states same-afternoon assignment

repairs.defect: explanation contradicted timeline (booking 'last night' would be on a 6 a.m. list)
repairs.repair: booking moved to 8 a.m. today; key, why and comparison rewritten

repairs.defect: counting convention ambiguous; wrong-reasoning distractor inconsistent with its stated count
repairs.repair: contract states counting starts next business day; distractor recomputed (Wednesday)

repairs.defect: two-trip distractor met the rating (230+20=250), a tie with the key
repairs.repair: person weight 245 lb; every carried load exceeds the rating

repairs.defect: prompt asked for a conclusion but options were source labels
two options were near inverses of each other
repairs.repair: one replaced with a surge-protector rationale

systematic_repairs: Scenario-echo cue: best answers reused the scenario's procedure wording; shortened keys and added scenario vocabulary to distractors until the unique-top share was at most 50 percent in every skill.
Length cue: after echo repairs several skills drifted toward a shorter key (shortest-is-best 0.40 in four skills, at the limit); not worse than that.
Absolute-word cue: distractors containing never/ignore/nothing were reworded.
known_remaining_ambiguity: authored:tool-thermometer-calibration: 'use the probe, only two weeks overdue' is weaker than the key but is not violated by the second stated rule; a reader could argue partial defensibility.
Evaluate Credibility: about half of keys resolve to consulting the authoritative source the scenario names, which may teach a pattern.
